public.public_active_matching_bundle.name: public_active_matching_bundle
public.public_active_matching_bundle.definition:
select
    "matching_bundle_builds"."id" as build_id,
    "matching_bundle_builds"."schema_version" as schema_version,
    "matching_bundle_builds"."feature_contract" as feature_contract,
    "matching_bundle_builds"."manifest_sha256" as manifest_sha256,
    "matching_bundle_publications"."activated_at" as activated_at
  from "matching_bundle_publications"
  inner join "matching_bundle_builds" on "matching_bundle_builds"."id" = "matching_bundle_publications"."build_id"
  where "matching_bundle_publications"."channel" = 'public'
    and "matching_bundle_publications"."retired_at" is null
    and "matching_bundle_builds"."state" = 'verified'

public.public_crawl_status.name: public_crawl_status
public.public_crawl_status.definition:
select
    "sources"."slug" as source_slug,
    latest.started_at as last_run_started_at,
    latest.status as last_run_status,
    completed.finished_at as last_completed_at
  from "sources"
  left join lateral (
    select runs.started_at, runs.status
    from (
      select "crawl_runs"."started_at" as started_at, "crawl_runs"."status" as status
      from "crawl_runs"
      where "crawl_runs"."source_id" = "sources"."id"
      union all
      select "realestate"."crawl_runs"."started_at", "realestate"."crawl_runs"."status"::text::crawl_run_status
      from "realestate"."crawl_runs"
      where "realestate"."crawl_runs"."source_id" = "sources"."id"
    ) runs
    order by runs.started_at desc
    limit 1
  ) latest on true
  left join lateral (
    select runs.finished_at
    from (
      select "crawl_runs"."finished_at" as finished_at
      from "crawl_runs"
      where "crawl_runs"."source_id" = "sources"."id"
        and "crawl_runs"."status" = 'completed'
        and "crawl_runs"."finished_at" is not null
      union all
      select "realestate"."crawl_runs"."finished_at"
      from "realestate"."crawl_runs"
      where "realestate"."crawl_runs"."source_id" = "sources"."id"
        and "realestate"."crawl_runs"."status" = 'completed'
        and "realestate"."crawl_runs"."finished_at" is not null
    ) runs
    order by runs.finished_at desc
    limit 1
  ) completed on true

public.public_opportunities.name: public_opportunities

select
    "opportunities"."id" as id,
    "opportunities"."canonical_title" as canonical_title,
    "opportunities"."canonical_status" as canonical_status,

  from "opportunities"

public.public_opportunity_members.name: public_opportunity_members
public.public_opportunity_members.definition:
select
    "opportunity_source_memberships"."opportunity_id" as opportunity_id,
    "source_listings"."id" as source_listing_id,
    "sources"."slug" as source_slug,
    "source_listings"."status" as status,
    "source_listing_revisions"."title_raw" as title,
    "source_listing_revisions"."organization_raw" as organization,
    "source_listings"."canonical_source_url" as canonical_url,
    "source_listings"."source_published_at" as published_at,
    "source_listings"."source_deadline_at" as deadline_at,
    "source_listings"."first_seen_at" as first_seen_at,
    "source_listings"."last_seen_at" as last_seen_at,
    "source_listing_revisions"."application_method" as application_method,
    case
      when ("source_policies"."display"->>'mayRepublishFullContent')::boolean is true
        and "sources"."policy_conflict_at" is null
        then "source_listing_revisions"."description"
      else ''
    end as description,
    "source_listing_revisions"."locations" as locations,
    "source_listing_revisions"."salary_raw" as salary_raw,
    "source_listing_revisions"."source_categories" as source_categories,
    "source_listing_revisions"."structured_attributes" as structured_attributes
  from "opportunity_source_memberships"
  inner join "source_listings" on "source_listings"."id" = "opportunity_source_memberships"."source_listing_id"
  inner join "sources" on "sources"."id" = "source_listings"."source_id"
  inner join "source_listing_revisions" on "source_listing_revisions"."id" = "source_listings"."current_revision_id"
  left join "source_policies" on "source_policies"."id" = "sources"."current_policy_revision_id"
  where "opportunity_source_memberships"."superseded_at" is null
    and "source_listings"."status" <> 'quarantined'

public.public_source_listings.name: public_source_listings
public.public_source_listings.definition:
select
    "source_listings"."id" as source_listing_id,

    "source_listings"."first_seen_at" as first_seen_at,

  inner join "source_listing_revisions" on "source_listing_revisions"."id" = "source_listings"."current_revision_id"
  where "source_listings"."status" <> 'quarantined'

realestate_archive.recently_gone.definition:
select "id" as "listing_id", "source_id" as "source_id", "source_listing_key" as "source_listing_key", "deal_type" as "deal_type", "property_type" as "property_type", "commercial_type" as "commercial_type", "land_type" as "land_type", "rooms" as "rooms", "bedrooms" as "bedrooms", "area_m2" as "area_m2", "floor" as "floor", "total_floors" as "total_floors", "price_gel" as "price_gel", "price_usd" as "price_usd", "price_per_m2_usd" as "price_per_m2_usd", "price_per_m2_gel" as "price_per_m2_gel", "currency_posted" as "currency_posted", "city_ref" as "city_ref", "city_name" as "city_name", "district_ref" as "district_ref", "district_name" as "district_name", "subdistrict_ref" as "subdistrict_ref", "subdistrict_name" as "subdistrict_name", "municipality_ref" as "municipality_ref", "municipality_name" as "municipality_name", "street_name" as "street_name", "street_number" as "street_number", "poster_type" as "poster_type", "poster_entity" as "poster_entity", "image_count" as "image_count", "has_furniture" as "has_furniture", "has_built_in_kitchen" as "has_built_in_kitchen", "building_status" as "building_status", "condition" as "condition", "project" as "project", "floor_type" as "floor_type", "bathrooms" as "bathrooms", "balconies" as "balconies", "kitchen_area" as "kitchen_area", "house_area" as "house_area", "yard_area" as "yard_area", "amenities" as "amenities", "details_read_at" as "details_read_at", "similarity_group" as "similarity_group", "source_created_at" as "source_created_at", "source_updated_at" as "source_updated_at", "first_seen_at" as "first_seen_at", "last_seen_at" as "last_seen_at", "gone_at" as "gone_at", "gone_reason" as "gone_reason", coalesce(

  or ("property_type" <> 'land'
      and "area_m2" > case when "property_type" = 'flat' then 1000 else 10000 end
      and "price_per_m2_usd" < 100)
  or ("deal_type" = 'sale' and "price_usd" < 5000)
  or ("deal_type" = 'pledge' and "price_usd" < 1000)
  or ("deal_type" = 'rent' and ("price_usd" > 50000 or "price_usd" < 50 or "price_usd" >= 200 * "area_m2"))
  or ("deal_type" = 'daily' and ("price_usd" > 5000 or "price_usd" < 5)),
